subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): keep blank credentials from overriding AWS auth

question: Is it acceptable for a Bedrock default-chain request to delete whitespace-only AWS credential variables from the shared gateway process, or must blank-value filtering be scoped to Bedrock SDK client resolution?
rationale: The patch fixes the documented AWS SDK behavior, but the intended compatibility contract for process-global environment mutation cannot be established from source behavior and tests alone.

options.title: Accept shared-process cleanup
options.body: Merge the current implementation and treat whitespace-only AWS credential values as invalid process-wide inputs once Bedrock needs the default credential chain.

options.title: Scope cleanup to Bedrock
options.body: Require a Bedrock-owned credential-provider or client-construction path that bypasses blank values without mutating `process.env` for other gateway consumers.

recommendation.title: Scope cleanup to Bedrock
recommendation.body: Require a Bedrock-owned credential-provider or client-construction path that bypasses blank values without mutating `process.env` for other gateway consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a provider-authentication compatibility choice rather than a mechanical test or formatting repair.
